title: Temperature: Reading Thermometers in Degrees Celsius
seo_title: Grade 5 Temperature Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Measure and record temperature in degrees Celsius (°C) using thermometers; read and compare temperatures (positive values only).
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 5 temperature worksheets: reading thermometers, likely temperatures, differences and temperature tables. 100 questions with memos.
key_big: Read what each mark on the thermometer is worth.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Temperature is measured in degrees Celsius (°C) with a thermometer.
  • Water freezes at 0 °C and boils at 100 °C. Our body is about 37 °C.
  • Find what each mark on the thermometer is worth before you read it.
  • To find a difference, subtract the lower temperature from the higher one.

Examples

Example

Morning 12 °C, afternoon 27 °C

27 − 12

Answer: 15 °C warmer

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
The wrong intervalWork out each mark first.
Subtracting the wrong wayHigher − lower.
Not sensibleA hot day is about 30 °C, not 80 °C.
